description: What this server knows and which tool reads it: every kind of fact (person, membership, roster, commitfest entry, feature, decision, position, ...) with its attributes, value types, cardinality, docs and counts, and which kinds refer to which; the design-history graph's relations (thread DISCUSSES feature, decision DECIDES feature, person HOLDS position ABOUT feature, ...), sources (git, commitfest, rule, operator, model) and confidence rules (shown at 0.8 and above, "probably" from 0.5, hidden below; models capped at 0.9); the tables the tools read; and what is loaded (commits, tags, entries). Call it first to learn what can be asked. No arguments. Same as GET /api/v2/ontology.
name: get_ontology
